purpose: Replacement validation-only v10 preflight after the prior plan's PatchTST commands were invalidated by a global candidate-only flag.
research_question: Can a fixed channel order derived only from train signed-ACF profiles close the ETTh1 H336 gap while retaining a direct AutoCon representation forecast path?
architecture: MambaTSv10 uses one existing v3 channel-major patch Mamba scan. Signed-ACF profiles are fitted on the training split only at lags 24 and 48; a deterministic greedy similarity path becomes a fixed channel permutation used in train and evaluation before channels are restored. AutoCon's shared representation feeds a zero-initialized forecast residual. This is a VAST-lite local approximation, not official learned VPT/ATSP reproduction.
external_reference: Official MambaTS VPT/VAST implementation: https://github.com/XiudingCai/MambaTS-pytorch. Its learned transition-cost inference order is intentionally not reproduced here.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory preflight. No test metric is produced, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A pass only licenses fresh-seed multi-dataset confirmation and matched prediction-only resource measurement; it licenses neither an official reproduction claim nor test release.
prelaunch_gates: verify ETTh1 SHA256 and multivariate dimensions
verify MambaTSv10 direct AutoCon forecast connection
fit ACF from train split only and store its sidecar
isolate candidate-only flags from PatchTST commands
retain exactly one Mamba scan and fixed evaluation order

phases.name: v10_autocon_null
phases.purpose: Exact v10 graph and fixed train-only ACF order with AutoCon lambda zero.

phases.name: v10_autocon_active
phases.purpose: Exact v10 graph and fixed train-only ACF order with AutoCon lambda 0.001.

phases.name: patchtst_baseline
phases.purpose: Same-contract PatchTST baseline without candidate-only flags.

primary_contrasts: v10 active versus exact v10 lambda-zero control
comparison_contract.resource_gate: After an accuracy pass, benchmark prediction-only v10 and PatchTST under exact B32/L96/C7/H336 with 50 warm-up and 200 timed GPU forwards.

stopping_rules: Do not change the ACF source, lags, ordering algorithm, lambda, seeds, or budget after launch.
Stop v10 before multi-dataset expansion if active mean validation MSE is higher than PatchTST or if active is not lower than its exact null in at least two of three seed pairs.
No test release, resource claim, or hyperparameter adjustment is allowed if either condition fails.
